en: This postcard features an elegant city square with a fountain in the center, surrounded by grand 19th-century European buildings and park-like landscaping, with people strolling and sitting on benches. On the back, it includes handwritten text in Swedish and mailing details, addressed to Chicago, USA. The top of the image side identifies the location as 'Sundsvall. Vängåfvan.'
